title: Command token gain: headline names the count
description: A command-token gain showed the engine's one-token prompt ('gain a command token into which pool') as its headline even when the player gains two or three tokens at once. The distribution panel itself was already one screen for all tokens and is unchanged; only the headline (dialog title, aria title, minimised banner, shell prompt) now reads 'Gain N command tokens — assign them to pools' (or 'Gain 1 command token — choose its pool'), derived from the engine's display-only tokens_to_place. Web only; no engine or server change. Before shots are taken with the change reverted and committed under before/; after shots come from npm run screenshots -- BP. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.
